work.name: Justyou Apparels
highlights: Built a production hybrid RAG + SQL chatbot, combining retrieval over 500+ pages of challans with invoice lookups from PostgreSQL (FastAPI backend), letting customers query statements and dispatch status, with 2.47s average end-to-end latency (10-document, 864-chunk eval corpus).
Evaluated retrieval quality on a 60-query test set: a 70/30 weighted hybrid of HashingVectorizer TF-IDF and BM25 reached 92% accuracy versus 69% for TF-IDF alone.
Cut peak memory from approximately 700MB (OOM crash) to 60 to 80MB by replacing TfidfVectorizer with HashingVectorizer, which keeps memory fixed as the corpus grows.

Built three-layer anti-poisoning pipeline (regex sanitization, binary hard-cap trust scoring, retrieval-time blocking) to keep LLM answers reliable and safe against prompt injection through ingested documents.
Tested the pipeline against 20 adversarial prompt-injection attempts across 4 attack categories and stopped all 20.

work.name: Justyou Apparels
highlights: Led a team of 2 engineers (mentoring them) to build the company’s entire ERP, using FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Celery/Redis, React/Next.js, and AWS (EC2, RDS).

Solved a cash-flow crunch that was delaying vendor payments by building Playwright automations for WhatsApp (auto-sending product images on request) and Instagram lead generation (finding active buyers on niche pages and sending them the group invite). Cash sales (no credit) grew from ₹1.5 crore to ₹7 crore (~4.7x).
Fixed slow website image loading by automating the conversion of images into lightweight HTML-rendered pixel data, so pages load as native HTML, cutting page load time from 6s to 2s.
Cut the production cycle by ~80%, from 150-160 days to ~30 days (raw material purchase to production-ready), and scaled daily output from 90-100 to 1,500-1,600 pieces (~16x).
Built and managed a network of 25 large vendors, securing reliable supply and 8.25% better pricing/lead times.
Scaled and led an organization of 400+ people across production, sales, and operations.

work.name: Lawnics Technologies
highlights: Improved four-corner detection accuracy from ~78% to ~92% on low-resolution and low-quality images (<2 MP, poor lighting, skewed angles) by tuning preprocessing and edge/contour logic, tested on 500+ sample documents.
Designed data pipelines using PostgreSQL (relational) and Firebase (NoSQL), handling 10K+ records, and used Firebase Analytics to track user behavior and guide feature decisions.
Integrated Razorpay payments (checkout, webhooks, payment verification), processing 500+ transactions with a 98%+ success rate.

work.name: Lawnics Technologies
highlights: Integrated native C++ libraries into the Android environment using CMake build scripts, cutting image processing time by 60%.
Delivered 2 production features end to end, from UI implementation to algorithm integration, with no disruption to existing app functionality.

research.name: PingPilot: Graph-Structured Action Prediction for Web Agents
highlights: Identified element grounding, not action prediction, as the core failure mode on Multimodal Mind2Web, then fused a DOM graph attention network into a frozen Qwen3-VL-8B backbone via a gated cross-attention adapter and LoRA, all within a single 24GB GPU.

Lifted element accuracy from 12.7% (no graph) to 49.5% and beat the strongest multimodal baseline by ~12 points with step accuracy reaching ~41%; showed these gains did not fully reach task success (7.75%) due to error accumulation over long trajectories.
Traced fixation and anchor-bias failures to the static per-step graph and fragile node pruning, and proposed dynamic node masking and topology-aware retention as fixes.

projects.name: PingPilot: Automation of Web Tasks using Multimodal LLMs and Playwright
highlights: Built a multimodal web agent that can perform complex web tasks (e.g., filling forms, navigating pages) using a combination of LLMs and Playwright.
Implemented a feedback loop where the agent learns from its mistakes and improves its performance over time.
Achieved a task success rate of 85% on a benchmark set of web tasks, outperforming existing solutions by 20%.
Built web and android applicationn on django and android respectively with schema design and database management for the same along with razorpay payment integration.
Managed the team and created Registration Portal for JU Rhythm for Onsite Registrations of more than 500+ participants.
